notes: Top-line: building agent + ticket deflection layer for a mid-size helpdesk platform. Primary goal is reduce live-agent load by 30-40% with high precision top-5 suggestions.
User quote: "We need sub-200ms p95 for interactive agent handoffs — customers notice delays under 300ms."
Current infra: in-house vector DB + cheap cross-encoder reranker on CPU; scaling pain at 20M indexed docs. Looking to offload inference and improve rerank quality.

Cost sensitivity: target total cost per query (retrieve + rerank) <= $0.35 for steady state; POC tolerates higher but wants clear roadmap to $0.20-$0.30 range.
Compliance: EU customers require data residency; POC can run in NA but production must support EU VPC/private deployment or dedicated capacity in eu-west region.
Evaluation focus: latency SLOs, indexing throughput (30M+ docs), incremental reindex workflow, and rerank quality (human eval: >85% top-5 precision on canned set).
